name: Anu LMS Example: Custom page data
description: Example module showing how to add custom data to Anu LMS lesson and courses page payloads via events.
project_description: Example submodule of Anu LMS (package 'Anu LMS Examples'). Demonstrates extending the decoupled page payload by subscribing to the CoursesPageDataGeneratedEvent and LessonPageDataGeneratedEvent: the subscriber appends extra keys to the data array sent to the React front end and shows a status message. A copy-and-adapt template for developers, not meant to be enabled in production.
